description: This file defines a class PersistableProductReview that extends ProductReviewEntity, adds a customerId field with getter and setter, and implements Serializable.

classes.name: PersistableProductReview
classes.description: A serializable entity class representing a product review with an associated customer ID, extending ProductReviewEntity.

methods.name: getCustomerId
methods.description: Returns the customer ID associated with the product review.

methods.name: setCustomerId
methods.description: Sets the customer ID associated with the product review.
